An JSON formatted object literal used to specify options for the vector distance calculation.
Docs.summary: Returns the similarity score between two specified vectors. For more information, see https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cosmos-db/nosql/query/vectordistance. This method is to be used in LINQ expressions only and will be evaluated on server. There's no implementation provided in the client library.

example.code: var matched = documents.Select(document => document.vector1.VectorDistance(<vector2>, true, new VectorDistanceOptions() { DistanceFunction = DistanceFunction.Cosine, DataType = VectorDataType.Int8}));
